data.user_prompt: Which companies help businesses in the UAE get ready for e-invoicing? List up to 6 with their websites.

sections.text:
The UAE Ministry of Finance’s accredited-provider register lists companies that can help businesses prepare for and implement e-invoicing. Six examples are:

- **Advintek Consulting Services LLC** — https://www.einvoice.advintek.ae
- **Azentio Software Orion (Middle East) FZ-LLC** — https://www.azentio.com
- **BBIT Accqrate Technology FZCO** — https://www.bbit-accqrate.com/ae/en
- **BDO Digital Solutions FZ-LLC** — https://www.bdo.ae/en-gb/home
- **Cloud Consulting LLC-FZ (DocFlow)** — https://www.docflow.ae
- **Comarch Middle East FZ LLC** — https://www.comarch.com/trade-and-services/data-management/e-invoicing

These companies appear on the UAE Ministry of Finance’s accredited or pre-approved e-invoicing service-provider lists.[1][2]
